response.justification: The candidate is a clearly experienced and versatile senior engineer with strong web, backend, and systems experience, but the profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role. Modern hands-on C++ experience is minimal (a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project), and there is no evidence of MQTT, IEC 62443, Secure Development Lifecycle practices, or industrial automation protocol experience. Recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, not the C++/STL, multi-threaded, industrial-cybersecurity focus this position requires.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, exceeding the 8–12 year requirement
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby, transferable to performance-critical work
Strong mentoring, testing, and knowledge-sharing track record (workshops, TDD, open-source projects)
concerns: Almost no recent or substantial professional C++ experience; primary languages are TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No exposure to IEC 62443, SDL, MQTT, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, DNP 3.0)
No industrial automation or OT/IoT product background; career trajectory points toward web/cloud/AI tooling rather than embedded industrial systems

key_factors.factor: No industrial cybersecurity/IEC 62443 or MQTT experience
Strong systems/performance engineering and mentoring background
